🚨DHS just shared with me some the WORST OF THE WORST illegals who were deported last week including murderers and sex offenders

This is who Democrats are rioting in the streets to protect!

Let that sink in.

Esteban Demecio Hernandez, a criminal illegal alien from Mexico, deported on July 31. His criminal history includes convictions for second-degree murder, gross vehicular manslaughter, and TWO counts of driving under the influence of liquor.

Sue Vang, a criminal illegal alien from Laos, deported on July 28. His criminal history includes a conviction for first-degree criminal sexual conduct.
 
Darshankumar Ashwinkumar Patel, a criminal illegal alien from India, deported on July 29. His criminal history includes convictions for domestic abuse, harassment, and driving while intoxicated.

Wilson Amilcar Vasquez-Caballero, a criminal illegal alien from Honduras, deported on July 27. His criminal history includes convictions for burglary, possession of stolen property, driving under the influence, and illegal re-entry, and an arrest for hit and run.

Abaye Tafesse, a criminal illegal alien from Ethiopia, deported on July 29. His criminal history includes a conviction for possession with intent to distribute at least 5 kilograms of cocaine, at least 50 grams of cocaine base, and at least 50 grams of methamphetamine. 

“By removing these criminals, we are making America safe again. Under President Trump’s leadership, we are enforcing the law. Do NOT attempt to enter our nation illegally: we will find you, arrest you, and deport you.” - @SecMullinDHS 

Bye bye! 👋
